list.title: Agent flows
list.empty: No agents yet; create an agent first.
list.noneSelected: Pick an agent's flow on the left.

inspector.empty: Select a node or an edge on the canvas to edit it.
inspector.emptyHint: Connect nodes by dragging from their bottom to another node's top. A route node's edges carry labels; the unlabelled edge is the default arm.
inspector.whenHint: The route matches this label against the last output (per mode). Exactly one edge may stay empty: the default arm.
inspector.linearEdge: A linear edge; it carries no label.
inspector.title: Title
inspector.contextHint: Thread: the session history + this prompt as the new user message. Fresh: only the system prompt + this prompt.
inspector.toolsHint: No tools: a plain completion (cheaper for critic/classify stages).
inspector.agentHint: Another agent may run this stage (e.g. a critic).
inspector.modelHint: Model id for this stage only; empty = the agent's model.
inspector.outputSchemaHint: Structured output on supporting providers; pair with a JSON route.
inspector.modeHint: How the last output is compared with the arm labels. Judge: the decision model (JEV) picks the arm (flow-judge authority). Criteria: the decision model checks every criterion; all met takes the "pass" arm, anything else "fail" (flow-criteria authority).
inspector.question: Question for the judge
inspector.questionHint: Tells the decision model what to look at.
inspector.maxVisitsHint: The route picks a labelled arm at most this many times per turn, then takes the default arm (loops always end).
inspector.noArms: No arms yet; drag an edge from this node on the canvas.
inspector.noteHint: Why this stage exists; agents and the observer read it.
inspector.criteriaHint: One yes/no statement about the last output per line (e.g. "The reply is in Turkish", "At most two sentences"). The decision model checks them all in one call; every criterion met takes the arm labelled "pass", otherwise the arm labelled "fail". The unlabelled arm is the fallback when no model can answer.
inspector.criteriaPlaceholder:
The reply answers the question directly
No fabricated facts
inspector.automationHint: When this node runs, the selected automation fires with the payload template as {{result}} (its own guards — enabled, cooldown, iteration cap — apply). The flow's last output passes through unchanged.
inspector.noAutomations: No automations yet; create a rule on the Automations screen.
inspector.payloadHint: Appears as {{result}} in the automation's prompt template; {{input}}, {{last}}, {{node.<id>}} are available. Empty = {{last}}.

runs.emptyHint: Chat with {{name}}; every turn runs through this flow and shows up here as a run.
runs.gradeTitle: The decision model's grade of the reply (confidence {{pct}}%)

evolution.policyHint: The observer (flow-optimizer system agent) looks at the recent runs every N runs and proposes one change. Propose: you approve. Auto: a proposal above the confidence floor is applied by itself. Every version can be reverted.
evolution.allowPromptChanges: The observer may also change the agent's prompts
evolution.optimizeApplied: A proposal was produced and applied.
evolution.optimizeProposed: A proposal was filed; review it below.
evolution.proposalsHint: Changes filed by the observer or the agent. Apply commits them onto the head as a new version.
evolution.versionsHint: Every save, agent edit and observer application is a new version. Reverting opens a new version too; history is never lost.
evolution.promptVersionsHint: The agent's soul/identity is versioned here whenever the observer or the agent changes it.
evolution.noPromptVersions: The prompt has not evolved yet.
evolution.optimizeHeld: A proposal was filed; {{reason}}. You can apply it below.

policy.autoHint: Applies proposals above the confidence floor by itself.

test.hint: The input runs as one turn in a fresh chat session for {{name}}; the stages light up live.
test.waiting: Turn queued, waiting for the first stage…

save.title: Save as v{{v}}
save.hint: The reason goes into the version history; the observer reads it too.
save.placeholder: Why did it change? (e.g. answers went out unchecked, added a critic loop)

lint.oneInput: Exactly one input node is required ({{count}} present)
lint.oneOutput: Exactly one output node is required ({{count}} present)
lint.danglingEdge: Edge {{id}} points at a missing node
lint.oneOutgoing: Node {{id}} must have exactly one outgoing edge ({{count}} present)
lint.outputNoOutgoing: The output node {{id}} cannot have outgoing edges
lint.criteriaArms: route {{id}} has no arm labelled pass or fail
